name: Lipschitz Bound Computation for Skeletal Primitives
aliases: Falloff Filter Function Lipschitz Bound Computation
definition: A method to compute the Lipschitz bound λ for skeletal primitives by evaluating the maximum of the absolute value of the derivative g'(x) on an interval [a,b], which involves finding zeroes of the second-order derivative g''(x).
summary: This method computes tight local Lipschitz bounds for skeletal primitives using closed-form analytical solutions, enabling larger safe steps in sphere tracing without numerical approximation errors.
